scope: constrained scene workflow; adapter supplies API syntax, not intrinsic coding gain

messages.system:
Describe the requested plot using this declarative schema. Return a JSON object only, with these fields:
size: [width,height]; axes: array of {id,row,col,title,xlabel,ylabel};
plots: ordered array of {kind,axis,x,y,color?,alpha?,label?} for kind lines or scatter,
or {kind:"band",axis,x,lower,upper,color?,alpha?,label?}.
Data expressions are input names, finite numbers, {op:"abs",arg:expr}, or
{op:"+"|"-"|"*"|"/",left:expr,right:expr}; operations are elementwise.
links: array of {dimension:"x"|"y",axes:[axis ids]};
legends: array of {axis,position:"lt"|"rt"|"lb"|"rb"};
returns: ordered array of "fig" and axis ids.
Use only supplied input names. Colors: blue,red,black,green,orange,gray,purple.
No extra fields. Optional text attributes may be omitted. No Julia code.

messages.user:
Using Makie (not GLMakie), write function makeplot(x,y) returning (fig, ax1, ax2). Figure size (720,480), two vertically stacked Axis objects; plot y versus x as lines on ax1 and abs.(y) versus x as scatter on ax2. Link only x axes with linkxaxes!. Upper title: Signal; upper ylabel: Amplitude; lower xlabel: Time (s); lower ylabel: Magnitude. No display, save, or backend activation. Code only, including imports.
Instead of Julia code, return scene JSON. Available input names: x, y
